description: This source file defines a Spring service class `LibraryThingBookImportService` responsible for importing books from LibraryThing data into the application. It uses a mapper to convert import data to Book entities and a service to save them to the database.

classes.name: LibraryThingBookImportService
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles importing books from LibraryThing data, converting them via a mapper, and saving them using the BookService.

methods.name: importBooksFrom
methods.description: Imports a list of LibraryThingBookImport objects, converts each to a Book entity, saves it via BookService, and returns the list of saved Books.
